thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: kubelet flapping on eu-west inference pool. Node group infer-eu-west-3 showing 3 nodes NotReady in last 6m. Alert: increased 500s and pod restarts. Pager: @Ana

Ana: I'm on it. Looking at k8s console now. See kubelet restart loop on gpu-node-7, gpu-node-8, gpu-node-9. Logs show repeated: 'kubelet: failed to start container: runtime error: failed to create runtime: failed to create container: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = nvidia-smi: process exited with status 1'

Mike: grabbing metrics — spike in 5xx at ~15:12 UTC, baseline 1.8% -> now 6.3%. p95 latency from 120ms -> 420ms for inference batches. A subset of Dedicated customers routed through eu-west seeing errors.

Ana: marking nodes cordoned and starting drains. running:

```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-7
kubectl drain gpu-node-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

Sara: good call. I'll scale the inference pool up +2 replicas while we do this — autoscaler minReplicas bump in place.

Ana: drain succeeded on gpu-node-7. Attempting drain on gpu-node-8 but pods keep failing to terminate due to driver/container crashes. Log excerpt:

```
containerd: time="2026-03-15T15:14:23Z" level=error msg="container start failed: container_linux.go:348: starting container process caused \"process_linux.go:402: container init caused \\\"container_linux.go:xxx: failed to start container process: error setting up device: nvidia: failed to load driver\\\"\""
```

Lee: Could be GPU driver crash after a kernel/AMI push. infra-deploy shows a canary kernel rollout in eu-west ~2h ago.

Chris: Rolling back kernel across nodes will take time. For immediate mitigation let's shift traffic away from eu-west and spin up replacement nodes with the stable image. I'll adjust routing now to 80% us-west, 20% eu-west.

Ana: executing routing change via smart-router:
`/admin route set infer-eu-west weight=20`

pagerduty-bot: @Mike assigned as secondary on-call for 30m

Mike: I can ssh into gpu-node-8 to try restarting driver services. Do you want me to try `sudo systemctl restart nvidia-persistenced`?

Ana: yes try that. attempting restart now but seeing `Failed to start: Unit not found` — driver install seems corrupted, module missing. Also sudo dmesg shows repeated `NVRM: Xid (79) GPU has fallen off the bus` errors.

Sara: annotate/taint remaining suspect nodes so we don't reschedule critical pods there:

`kubectl annotate node/gpu-node-8 redwood/incident=isolated && kubectl taint nodes gpu-node-8 infra/redwood=isolated:NoSchedule`

Ana: nvidia-driver-installer pods on node show OOM (killing processes). excerpt:

```
OutOfMemory: Killed process 12345 (installer) total-vm:...kB, anon-rss:...kB
Trace: package-install failed, exit code 137
```

Lee: OOM inside installer + kernel mismatch screams image/driver conflict. Mitigation plan: cordon remaining suspect nodes, provision fresh nodes with image tag `rinf-stable-2026-02-12`, join them to the pool, and allow scheduler to rebalance.

Chris: creating customer impact ticket CUST-4591; updating status page: "Investigating increased errors in eu-west inference pool." Notifying affected accounts.

Ana: replacement nodes booting, joining cluster. Traffic cutover in effect — error rate trending down to ~2.1%, p95 down to ~180ms. Continuing to monitor for 10m before uncordoning any nodes.

Mike: handing primary to Sara for monitoring, I'm off. Sara — you good to take watch? :coffee: 

Sara: ack, taking primary. I'll keep the dashboard open and alert if nodes don't stabilize in 15m. Escalate to infra if driver modules don't load on replacements.

incident-bot: Incident updated: acknowledged by Ana; mitigation in progress (traffic reroute + node replacement). Severity downgraded to Sev2 — monitoring.
